qualification.details: PGT Hindi: M.A. Hindi with Sanskrit and B.Ed, or Shastri examination from a recognized Sanskrit college affiliated to Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Varanasi. PGT Ganit (Mathematics): M.Sc. or M.Sc + B.Ed (3-year course), or B.Sc (Hons) in Mathematics. PGT Rasayan Vigyan (Chemistry): M.Sc. Chemistry, or B.Sc (3-year, Hons), or PG in Biochemistry from a UGC-recognized university, or PG Diploma in Chemistry from an education department-recognized institution with B.Sc. PGT Bhautik Vigyan (Physics): M.Sc. (Physics), or B.Sc with PG Diploma in Physics from a recognized university/college. Computer Vigyan: M.Tech/B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science), or MCA/M.Sc (Computer Science), or 'B' Level of DOEACC, or PG Diploma in Computer Applications, or B.Sc with computer-related course as detailed in the notification. Lab Assistant: High School with Science and Laboratory Technique Diploma, or Intermediate (Science stream) from a recognized board. Karyalay Adhikshak/Lipik: Intermediate pass (UP Board or equivalent), CCC/DOEACC certificate or Diploma/Degree in Computer Science, and minimum typing speed of 25 wpm Hindi and 30 wpm English. Poornkalik Shikshika (all subjects): Graduation in the relevant subject with B.Ed, plus Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for upper primary level (classes 6–8). Anshkalik Shikshika (Art, Craft & Music): Graduate with training diploma in Art/Craft/Music, or Home Science craft training. Anshkalik Shikshika (Computer): Graduate with training such as NIELIT-equivalent B.Ed/L.T, or PGDCA/BCA/B.Sc (CS) with 'O' Level. Anshkalik Shikshika (Sports & PE): B.P.Ed/C.P.Ed/D.P.Ed. TET is not mandatory for this post. Caretaker: Postgraduate with B.Ed. Lekhakar (Accountant): Graduate in Commerce with working knowledge of MS Office and DOEACC 'O' Level (or equivalent). Pradhan Rasoiya, Chaprasi, Chowkidar, Sahayak Rasoiya: Class 8 pass, along with physical fitness and freedom from any contagious disease.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Badaun Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: For teaching and office posts, selection is through a subject/category-wise merit list based on weighted marks, calculated as follows: In case of a tie in merit marks, the older candidate is ranked higher; if age is also equal, candidates are ranked alphabetically by name. For Pradhan Rasoiya, Sahayak Rasoiya, Chaprasi, and Chowkidar posts, selection is based on an interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced for KGBV Badaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 76 vacancies have been announced for various contractual posts under KGBV Badaun Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for KGBV Badaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates must send their applications via Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 25 years and 45 years of age to be eligible for the positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification varies by post, starting from 8th pass for support staff up to Graduation, Post Graduation, B.Ed, and professional degrees for teaching and administrative positions.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to the Office of District Basic Education Officer, Budaun, Near Police Line Crossing, Pin-243601.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for KGBV Badaun recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a merit list based on academic qualifications and an interview specifically for Chief Cook, Assistant Cook, Peon, and Watchman posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary range for KGBV Badaun personnel?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 6,433 to Rs. 25,410 per month depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for various educational and support positions under Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalaya, Budaun.
